name: XPRO India Ltd
about: XPRO India Ltd is engaged mainly in the business of polymers processing at multiple locations and is a leading manufacturer in India of Coextruded Plastic Films, thermoformed liners and specialty films (including dielectric films and special purpose BOPP Films).
keyPoints:
Coex Division (~67.74 % of revenues)[1]
The company's Coex Division manufactures coextruded sheets, thermoformed refrigerator liners and co-extruded cast films. Its products are used for refrigerator liners, disposable containers, automotive parts, etc.[2] It continues to be a leading supplier of sheets and liners in India for white goods of most leading brands.[3]

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.12%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.56% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.8% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.15.6 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 9.94% of profits over last 3 years
Debtor days have increased from 44.2 to 53.2 days.
